thread:
Asha: Quick post-launch pulse - retention on the smart-reply flow dropped ~11% and we have 6 regression tickets. Need to split between hotfix this week vs enhancements next sprint. My suggested rule: hotfix anything causing session loss, revenue/paid-customer impact, or SLA breaches. Others -> next sprint. Agree?

Tom: Agree. From triage: two session-loss crashers, one auth edge-case for SSO, two minor UI misrenders, one perf tail in embeddings.

Riley: Product note: the SSO edge-case hits 2 paying customers. That should be hotfix or targeted canary. UI misrenders can wait.

Selena: Dev estimates: session-loss fixes = 1d, SSO retry patch = 0.5d, embeddings tail investigation = 2d. Canary wiring ~0.25d.

Marco: Ops: prefer org-targeted canary for SSO and session fixes. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 3h with auto-rollback on any session-loss or error-rate +0.4%. Example config:
```
route_by: org_id
match: ["atlas","novus"]
percent: 5
```

Asha: Proposed decision: Wave A (hotfix this week) = session-loss crashers + SSO retry for affected orgs + org-targeted canary + CS comms. Wave B (next sprint) = embeddings perf hunt + UI polish. Obj?

Tom: Approve. Add acceptance criteria for Wave A: canary session-loss = 0 over 4h, error-rate delta <= +0.2% rolling 2h, p95 latency for key paths <= baseline +200ms. QA to verify before full promote.

Riley: I'll draft the CS note and tag the two customers.

Selena: I'll PR the SSO retry and add unit tests. Marco please provision canary route.

Marco: On it. I'll also add alerts: session-loss > 0 triggers immediate rollback.

QA Bot: CI snapshot: 117/120 passing. Will prioritize canary smoke tests and end-to-end sign-in after PRs land.

Asha: Owners recap: Selena (SSO + session fixes), Marco (canary + alerts), Riley (customer comms), Tom (triage + release sign-off), QA Bot (post-deploy checks). Target canary start tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

Selena: Will post PR by EOD.

Riley: CS note drafted, will send once canary starts.

Tom: Quick cost note: disabling a client-side cache as part of session fix may add ~1.5% token cost short-term. Acceptable tradeoff?

Asha: Acceptable for stability window. We'll monitor cost and revert when safe. Reconvene 2h after canary kickoff for a status pulse.

QA Bot: Smoke runs queued and will report results to channel.
